title: Zed Keymap Schema
description: A JSON schema validator for ZED. It surfaces issues with the JSON inline through the JSON LSP.

keymapItem.description:
Top level configuration object which requires at least 1 of 4 keys. context, binding, unbind, use_key_equivalents. .
Ex:

 - Stuff 
 - Foo 
 - Bar

use_key_equivalents.description: Flag on whether or not to substitute platform specific hot keys(MacOS cmd for Windows ctrl)

bindings.title: Bindings Map
bindings.description:
Key -> Value map of hotkeys to register. A key is a shortcut & it's value is the action/command it invokes. The "context" key can scope the bindings. 

 Ex: 
 "bindings": {
  "cmd-o": “workspace::Open”,
  "cmd-m": “zed::Minimize”,
  "cmd-,": “zed::OpenSettings”,
}

propertyNames.title: Keymap Key
propertyNames.description: Keyboard shortcut that triggers an action.

context.title: Context
context.description:
Runtime environment which hotkeys/actions are evaluated within (influencing scope/behavior). 
 - Auto complete key values to view available contexts. 

 Example: 
 Workspace, Editor, Terminal, ProjectPanel, OutlinePanel
context.$comment: One of contextName or contextExpression. Auto complete currently breaks due to limitation of JSON Schema Validator being unable to parse strings (Regex limitations).

contextExpression.title: Execution Context Expressions
contextExpression.description: Runtime environment which keymap command is executed (effecting behavior). View options by typing a key and seeing options
contextExpression.$comment: Context autocompletes single context item values. Boolean expressionses break the JSON Schema specification(is currently unable to continue autocompletion after an operator has been added ex: [vim_mode == full])

contextName.title: Execution Context
contextName.description: Runtime environment which keymap is evaluated (effecting behavior). Auto complete enabled
contextName.$comment: Enables autocomplete of single context item values. However the JSON Schema specification is currently unable to continue autocompletion after an operator has been added ex: (Editor == full)

unbind.description:
Key -> Value map of hotkeys to unregister. Context key is available to scope the unbinding.
Ex:

"unbind": {
  "cmd-o": “workspace::Open”,
  "cmd-m": “zed::Minimize”,
  "cmd-,": “zed::OpenSettings”,
}

actionKeyEnum.title: Shortcut Definition
actionKeyEnum.description:
Definition of shortcut which triggers an action. Multiple keys are seperated by a "-" and chords by a space. 
 Examples: 
 "cmd-shift-p"
